The '''Gunninga Gap''' was a [[spatial fissure]]<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="LSatSoM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> The interstellar space of the Gap blossomed with [[Moon tree|drifting moon trees]],<ref name="SM" /> among which the followers of a [[Death/Legends|death]] cult known as the [[Knell of Muspilli]]<ref name="BS" /> had found their sanctuary. The cultists believed they possessed the power to summon apocalyptic [[Deity/Legends|deities]] from the realm [[beyond shadows]].<ref name="BS" /> To achieve this, they transcribed the [[Taurannik Codex]], hoping to perform a ritual and open the Gap.<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

Many [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, during the era of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] adept [[Cronal]] explored the Unknown Regions, seeking knowledge that would grant him ultimate power. Within the Gunninga Gap, Cronal discovered scraps of the Codex, destroyed long ago during the [[Muurshantre Extinction|ancient cataclysm]],<ref name="SM" /> but he encountered no followers of the Knell of Muspilli, which might have indicated that the place had long since fallen into desolation.

==Behind the scenes==
The idea for the creation of the Gunninga Gap was inspired by [[wikipedia:en:Norse mythology|Norse mythology]], in which there existed [[wikipedia:en:Ginnungagap|Ginnungagap]], the primordial void and cosmic abyss.
